__readme: Shared fixtures for a provider refusing a request that does not fit the model's context window (PLB-300). ONE FILE, byte-identical in both repos: mcpjam-backend at tests/convex/fixtures/context-length-parity-fixtures.json (read by convex/lib/contextLengthError.ts tests) and the Inspector at sdk/tests/fixtures/context-length-parity-fixtures.json (read by the SDK error describer and the chat banner's count parser). Pinned by `context-length-parity-fixtures` in convex/lib/mirrors.json. Every `match` row must be recognized on both sides, every `noMatch` row on neither. `statusCode` null means the error carried no status; `responseBody` null means it carried no body. OpenRouter's `metadata.previous_errors` lists earlier attempts and is never read: only the current error decides. `counts` is what the Inspector's banner shows, or null when the sentence has no numbers. When a provider's wording is added, edit BOTH detectors and this file in the same PR.
